content:
**Aquaboy** or **Aquagirl** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk allows for swimming without receiving any radiation damage and also allows for underwater breathing.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You no longer take Rad damage from swimming and can breathe underwater. | 000E36F9 | 

Neither this nor the Lead Belly perk prevents radiation damage when collecting dirty water from a body of water or a water pump.

 Drinking toxic goo will not irradiate player characters, if they have the perk equipped. It must be unequipped for toxic goo to work. [verified]
